e.title: **在数据库里做 GLM，并拿另一套实现来验它**：一个 DuckDB 宏库把**七种广义线性模型**（含 Poisson／Gamma／Tweedie／负二项／多项）做成**纯 SQL**，**逐字写明「所有输出都与 statsmodels／scikit-learn 对到机器精度」**；**它还有**两条互不依赖的测试路径****——**一条用 Python 对标，**另一条逐字「不需要 Python，只要 DuckDB 命令行」**
e.title_en: Doing GLMs inside the database and verifying them against another implementation: a DuckDB macro library implements seven generalised linear model families including Poisson, Gamma, Tweedie, negative binomial and multinomial in pure SQL, states verbatim that all outputs are verified against statsmodels and scikit-learn to machine precision, and offers two independent test paths, one comparing against Python and the other needing no Python at all
e.title_hk: **在數據庫裡做 GLM，並拿另一套實現來驗它**：一個 DuckDB 宏庫把**七種廣義線性模型**（含 Poisson／Gamma／Tweedie／負二項／多項）做成**純 SQL**，**逐字寫明「所有輸出都與 statsmodels／scikit-learn 對到機器精度」**；**它還有**兩條互不依賴的測試路徑****——**一條用 Python 對標，**另一條逐字「不需要 Python，只要 DuckDB 命令行」**
e.summary: 一份**把广义线性模型整套搬进数据库引擎的宏库**（★1、**MIT**、Python、仓库体量 920 KB）：**逐字自述为**「**GLM regression (logistic, linear, Poisson, Gamma, Tweedie, negative binomial, multinomial) in pure DuckDB SQL**」**，**并逐字说明其形态为**「**Table macros for DuckDB 1.5+, no extensions and no driver required**」（**DuckDB 1.5 以上的表宏；**不需要扩展，也不需要驱动**）；**每一族都提供 **fit／predict／evaluate／summary（含标准误、p 值、置信区间）／预测区间／影响诊断****，**外加交叉验证、稳健与聚类稳健标准误**；**其最值得记的一处是它**拿另一套实现来验自己****——**逐字「**All outputs are verified against statsmodels / scikit-learn to machine precision.**」；**而第二处是它的**两条测试路径互不依赖****（**一条用 Python 对标 scikit-learn／statsmodels／numpy-scipy 的定种子数据，**另一条逐字为「**不需要 Python，只要 DuckDB 命令行**」**）；**第三处是它的**体量与功能的反差****——**实测整仓库只有 **15 个文件**，**而**整个库是**一个 SQL 文件**（**逐字「整个库就是一个由 `CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO` 语句构成的文件」**）**
e.summary_hk: 一份**把廣義線性模型整套搬進數據庫引擎的宏庫**（★1、**MIT**、Python、體量 920 KB）：**逐字自述為**「**GLM regression (logistic, linear, Poisson, Gamma, Tweedie, negative binomial, multinomial) in pure DuckDB SQL**」**，**並逐字說明其形態為**「**Table macros for DuckDB 1.5+, no extensions and no driver required**」**；**每一族都提供 **fit／predict／evaluate／summary（含標準誤、p 值、置信區間）／預測區間／影響診斷****，**外加交叉驗證、穩健與聚類穩健標準誤**；**其最值得記的一處是它**拿另一套實現來驗自己****——**逐字「**All outputs are verified against statsmodels / scikit-learn to machine precision.**」；**而第二處是它的**兩條測試路徑互不依賴****（**一條用 Python 對標 scikit-learn／statsmodels／numpy-scipy 的定種子數據，**另一條逐字為「**不需要 Python，只要 DuckDB 命令行**」**）；**第三處是它的**體量與功能的反差****——**實測整倉庫只有 **15 個文件**，**而**整個庫是**一個 SQL 文件**（**逐字「整個庫就是一個由 `CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO` 語句構成的文件」**）**
e.summary_en: A macro library that moves whole generalised linear models into a database engine, 1 star under MIT, a 920 KB Python repository, describing itself verbatim as GLM regression for logistic, linear, Poisson, Gamma, Tweedie, negative binomial and multinomial families in pure DuckDB SQL and stating verbatim that it is table macros for DuckDB 1.5 and above requiring no extensions and no driver. **Every family provides fit, predict, evaluate, summary with standard errors, p-values and confidence intervals, prediction intervals and influence diagnostics, plus cross-validation and robust or cluster-robust standard errors.** **Its most notable feature is that it verifies itself against another implementation**, verbatim that all outputs are verified against statsmodels and scikit-learn to machine precision, **and its second is that the two test paths are independent**, one comparing against scikit-learn, statsmodels and a numpy-scipy reference on fixed-seed data and the other needing, verbatim, no Python at all and only the DuckDB command line. **The third is the contrast between size and capability**: the repository measures just fifteen files, while the entire library is one SQL file, verbatim one file of macro replacement statements.
e.body:
**ducklm-sql-glm**（仓库 `lab1702/duckLM`）**是一份把广义线性模型整套搬进数据库引擎的宏库**：**逐字自述为**「**GLM regression (logistic, linear, Poisson, Gamma, Tweedie, negative binomial, multinomial) in pure DuckDB SQL**」**。**实测 ★1、fork 0、许可 **MIT**（**实测仓库内含 `LICENSE` 文件，**raw 探测 HTTP 200，**全文 **1,064 字节／21 行**、为标准 MIT 文本**；**GitHub 许可字段亦为 MIT**）、主语言 Python、仓库体量 **920 KB**、**创建 2026-07-12**、最后推送 2026-09-11**（**均 GitHub API 实测值；**创建与推送**都在解冻窗口之内****）；**README 实测 3,270 字节**；**仓库实测共 **15 个文件、1 个目录**（**经 GitHub API tree 接口实测，`truncated` 为 false；含 `tests/` 10 项、`CHEATSHEET.md`、`GUIDE.md`、`LICENSE`、`README.md`、`regression_macros.sql`**）**。本条目属于本轮主题**「自证：它拿什么证明自己」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本轮四条里**把「拿另一套独立实现来验自己」写得最明确的一条****。

可核实信息（**均 README 与 tree 实测**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它用**另一套实现**作为对齐对象，并给出对齐的精度**——**逐字为**：**「**All outputs are verified against **statsmodels / scikit-learn** to **machine precision**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **对齐对象是**两套独立实现**（**statsmodels 与 scikit-learn**）**——**⭐ 即**它没有只说「测试通过」，**而是**说出它与谁一致****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **精度被写成「机器精度」**（**`to machine precision`**）**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是一个**可被推翻的强主张**（**若有人在某个族上发现偏差，**这句话就错了**），**而**它敢这么写**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它覆盖的族数被逐条列出**（**七个：**logistic／linear／Poisson／Gamma／Tweedie／negative binomial／multinomial**）**——**⭐ 即**读者可以按族核对，**而不是接受一个总体的「已测试」**；**④ ⭐⭐ **它说明每一族都提供同样的六类输出**（**逐字含 `fit`、`predict`、`evaluate`、`summary`（标准误、p 值、置信区间）、预测区间与影响诊断**）**——**⭐ 即**对齐是**逐函数**的**。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **它有**两条测试路径，而且第二条**不需要 Python****——**逐字为**：**「**Two independent paths**（细节见 `tests/README.md`）**」**，**其中一条逐字为**「**Python suite: every fit/predict/summary checked against scikit-learn / statsmodels / a numpy-scipy reference on fixed-seed data**」，**另一条逐字为**「**Pure-SQL smoke test: no Python, just the DuckDB CLI**」，**并给出命令**（**`duckdb < tests/smoke.sql`**）**⭐⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **两条路径**不共用失败模式****——**⭐ 即**一条路径出问题时，**另一条仍能独立给出信号****（**⭐ 本词条认为这是**「自证」这一主题在本轮最实在的一处**：**不是测两遍，**而是**用两种不同的依赖集合各测一遍****）；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **定种子数据被写明**（**`fixed-seed data`**）**——**⭐ 即**对标用的数据**可复现**；**③ ⭐⭐ **第二条路径**不需要解释器****（**逐字「不需要 Python，只要 DuckDB 命令行」**）**——**⭐ 即**它考虑到了**没有 Python 环境的读者**（**⭐ 这与 [[motor-pricing-glm]] 的「`CASdatasets` 不在 CRAN 上、首次运行自行安装」形成对照：**一个想办法减依赖，**一个说明依赖特殊****）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **它的实现方式被写到细节，且每一处难做的地方都点名了**——**逐字为**：**「**Everything runs inside DuckDB: **training is Fisher-scoring IRLS by default** — with **coordinate descent for the L1 term**, and **Nesterov-accelerated gradient descent as an automatic fallback on a rank-deficient design** — all implemented with a **recursive CTE and list lambdas**, **sharing a single optimizer core across all families**; even the **coefficient covariance (matrix inversion) and the normal/Student-t distributions are computed in pure SQL**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **默认算法与两条退路各自具名**（**Fisher 打分 IRLS／坐标下降处理 L1 项／设计矩阵秩亏时自动退到 Nesterov 加速梯度下降**）**——**⭐ 即**读者知道**在什么情况下会发生什么****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **被点名的三件「本不该在 SQL 里做」的事**：**矩阵求逆（系数协方差）**、**正态分布**、**Student-t 分布**——**⭐ 本词条认为这是本条**最值得记的技术细节**：**它知道自己越过了什么边界，**并把越界的部分写出来****；**③ ⭐⭐ **一个共享的优化器核心服务所有族**（**逐字「在所有族之间共享同一个优化器核心」**）**——**⭐ 即**七个族不是七套复制品**；**④ ⭐⭐ **正则化与精算相关的两个参数都支持**（**逐字含 ridge／lasso／elastic-net、**offset／exposure 项**与样本权重**）**——**⭐ 即**「暴露度作为偏移项」这一精算建模的必需品**没有被省略**。**④ ⭐⭐ **它的部署摩擦被压到最低，且这一点是可核实的**——**逐字「**That is it — the whole library is one file of `CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO` statements.**」（**就是这样——整个库就是一个由宏替换语句构成的文件**）**；**加载方式是**「`.read regression_macros.sql`」**；**并逐字说明**它既可从命令行使用，**也可从任何驱动（Python／R／Node 等）调用**，**且表名与列名以**字符串**传入**⭐⭐ **三处值得记**：**① ⭐⭐ **一个文件、一次 `.read`**——**⭐ 即**没有安装步骤**（**⭐ 与常规 Python 包形成对照**）；**② ⭐⭐ **跨驱动可用**（**同一份宏在 Python／R／Node 下都跑**）**——**⭐ 即**它把语言选择还给了使用者**；**③ ⭐⭐ **列名以字符串传入**是一个**接口上的诚实说明**（**⭐ 即**用宏拼 SQL 的必然结果被直接写出来**，**而不是留给读者去踩**）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **它给了一个可以直接粘贴的例子**——**逐字给出三步**（**用 `poisson_fit(‘policies’,’n_claims’)` 建模型表**（**⚠️ 其原文此处用 ASCII 单引号 U+0027，**本词条按站内既有约定改用 U+2018／U+2019**）、**用 `poisson_summary` 取系数与标准误／p 值／置信区间、**用 `poisson_predict_ci` 对 `renewals` 做预测区间**）**——**⭐ 即**从一个保单表到一个带区间的预测**只需三行**。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **它的文档按用途切开**——**逐字说明 `CHEATSHEET.md` 是「**一页签名速查，**要快速查某个宏就从这里开始**」，**而 `GUIDE.md` 是「**面向任务的解释、示例、统计约定与完整的契约／边界情形行为**」**——**⭐ 本词条认为**「查」与「学」分在两份文件里**这个安排值得抄**（**⭐ 与 [[xaci]] 的「README 只放不属于任何单篇 vignette 的参考材料」同向**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ 可与本站条目并读**：[[glm]]、[[easy-glm]]、[[superglm]]、[[aglm]]、[[duckdb]]、[[insurance-glm-tools]]。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⭐ **许可为 **MIT****（**实测 `LICENSE` 为 **1,064 字节、21 行的标准 MIT 全文**，**GitHub 许可字段亦为 MIT**）**——**⭐ 本词条**仍未读该文件以外的权利说明**（**⚠️ 未核实其是否依赖第三方 SQL 代码**）。**② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **本次**没有运行它的任何一步****——**未安装 DuckDB、未 `.read` 该 SQL 文件、未跑 `pytest`、未跑 `duckdb < tests/smoke.sql`、未核对其任何一族与 statsmodels／scikit-learn 的偏差**；**故**本词条**不主张**其「对到机器精度」成立**——**⭐ 这一句是**本条最需要后续核实的一处**（**⭐ 而它恰好是**最容易核实的一句**：**跑一次 `tests/smoke.sql` 或 `pytest` 即可**；**⚠️ 本词条**未做**）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未读 `regression_macros.sql` 的任何内容****（**⭐ 即**未核对**它是否确实用递归 CTE 实现 IRLS、**是否确实在秩亏时退回 Nesterov、**以及**矩阵求逆与 t 分布是否确实在纯 SQL 中完成**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其在真实规模数据上的表现**（**⭐ 其自述**未给出性能数字**，**本词条**也不主张**它能替代常规实现**）**。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **一处**体裁上的判断**如实记录**：**本词条认为**「在数据库里做 GLM」**这件事的意义**不在于省一次导出**，**而在于**数据不出库**这一点**（**⭐ 其自述**只从**工程**角度说明**无扩展、无驱动**，**⚠️ 本词条**并未据其文字推断任何合规或隐私收益**；**⭐ 该推断属本词条，**已如此标注**）。**⑥ ⚠️ **★1、fork 0、无 topics**，**且**未核实作者背景**。**⑦ ⚠️ **创建在解冻窗口之内（2026-07-12）**，**最后推送 2026-09-11**。**⑧ ⚠️ **本条目所记为**2026-09-11 所见****。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/lab1702/duckLM` 于 2026-09-11 经仓库检索接口与 GitHub API 实测读取（★数、许可 MIT、语言、体量、创建／推送时间）；README 3,270 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对；`LICENSE` 的存在与**字节数（1,064）与行数（21）**经 raw 实测；**文件清单经 GitHub API tree 接口实测（15 个文件、1 个目录，`truncated` 为 false）**；**未克隆、未安装 DuckDB 或任何依赖、未运行任何 SQL 或测试、未打开任何文件内容、未做任何网络观察**。
e.body_hk:
**ducklm-sql-glm**（倉庫 `lab1702/duckLM`）**是一份把廣義線性模型整套搬進數據庫引擎的宏庫**：**逐字自述為**「**GLM regression (logistic, linear, Poisson, Gamma, Tweedie, negative binomial, multinomial) in pure DuckDB SQL**」**。**實測 ★1、fork 0、許可 **MIT**（**實測倉庫內含 `LICENSE`，raw 探測 HTTP 200，全文 **1,064 位元組／21 行**、為標準 MIT 文本；GitHub 許可字段亦為 MIT**）、主語言 Python、體量 **920 KB**、**創建 2026-07-12**、最後推送 2026-09-11**（**創建與推送都在解凍窗口之內****）；**README 實測 3,270 位元組**；**倉庫實測共 15 個文件、1 個目錄**（**經 GitHub API tree 接口實測，`truncated` 為 false；含 `tests/` 10 項、`CHEATSHEET.md`、`GUIDE.md`、`LICENSE`、`README.md`、`regression_macros.sql`**）。本條目屬本輪主題**「自證：它拿什麼證明自己」**；**⭐⭐⭐ 它是本輪四條裡**把「拿另一套獨立實現來驗自己」寫得最明確的一條****。

可核實資訊（**均 README 與 tree 實測**）：⭐⭐⭐ **① 它用**另一套實現**作為對齊對象，並給出對齊的精度**——**逐字「**All outputs are verified against **statsmodels / scikit-learn** to **machine precision**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐對齊對象是**兩套獨立實現****（沒有只說「測試通過」，而是說出與誰一致）；**② ⭐⭐⭐精度被寫成「機器精度」**（這是一個**可被推翻的強主張**——若有人在某族上發現偏差，這句話就錯了）；**③ ⭐⭐⭐覆蓋的族數被逐條列出**（七個：logistic／linear／Poisson／Gamma／Tweedie／negative binomial／multinomial——讀者可按族核對）；**④ ⭐⭐每一族都提供同樣的六類輸出**（逐字含 fit／predict／evaluate／summary（標準誤、p 值、置信區間）／預測區間／影響診斷——對齊是**逐函數**的）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **有**兩條測試路徑，而第二條**不需要 Python****——逐字「**Two independent paths**」，其中一條逐字「**Python suite: every fit/predict/summary checked against scikit-learn / statsmodels / a numpy-scipy reference on fixed-seed data**」，另一條逐字「**Pure-SQL smoke test: no Python, just the DuckDB CLI**」，並給出命令 `duckdb < tests/smoke.sql`**⭐⭐⭐ 三處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐兩條路徑**不共用失敗模式****（不是測兩遍，而是**用兩種不同的依賴集合各測一遍**——「自證」這一主題在本輪最實在的一處）；**② ⭐⭐⭐定種子數據被寫明**（對標用的數據**可復現**）；**③ ⭐⭐第二條路徑不需要解釋器**（考慮到**沒有 Python 環境的讀者**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **實現方式被寫到細節，且每一處難做的地方都點名了**——逐字「**Everything runs inside DuckDB: training is Fisher-scoring IRLS by default — with coordinate descent for the L1 term, and Nesterov-accelerated gradient descent as an automatic fallback on a rank-deficient design — all implemented with a recursive CTE and list lambdas, sharing a single optimizer core across all families; even the coefficient covariance (matrix inversion) and the normal/Student-t distributions are computed in pure SQL.**」**⭐⭐⭐ 四處**：**① ⭐⭐⭐默認算法與兩條退路各自具名**（Fisher 打分 IRLS／坐標下降處理 L1 項／設計矩陣秩虧時自動退到 Nesterov 加速梯度下降——讀者知道**在什麼情況下會發生什麼**）；**② ⭐⭐⭐被點名的三件「本不該在 SQL 裡做」的事**（矩陣求逆（係數協方差）／正態分布／Student-t 分布——**它知道自己越過了什麼邊界，並把越界的部分寫出來**）；**③ ⭐⭐一個共享的優化器核心服務所有族**；**④ ⭐⭐正則化與精算相關的兩個參數都支持**（ridge／lasso／elastic-net、**offset／exposure 項**與樣本權重——「暴露度作為偏移項」這一精算建模的必需品沒有被省略）。**④ ⭐⭐ **部署摩擦被壓到最低，且這一點可核實**——逐字「**That is it — the whole library is one file of `CREATE OR REPLACE MACRO` statements.**」；加載方式是「`.read regression_macros.sql`」；並逐字說明既可從命令行使用，也可從任何驅動（Python／R／Node 等）調用，且表名與列名以**字符串**傳入**三處**：**① ⭐⭐一個文件、一次 `.read`**（沒有安裝步驟）；**② ⭐⭐跨驅動可用**（同一份宏在 Python／R／Node 下都跑——把語言選擇還給使用者）；**③ ⭐⭐列名以字符串傳入**是**接口上的誠實說明**（用宏拼 SQL 的必然結果被直接寫出，而不是留給讀者去踩）。**⑤ ⭐⭐ **給了一個可以直接粘貼的例子**——逐字三步（`poisson_fit(‘policies’,’n_claims’)` 建模型表、`poisson_summary` 取係數與標準誤／p 值／置信區間、`poisson_predict_ci` 對 `renewals` 做預測區間——從一個保單表到一個帶區間的預測只需三行）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **文檔按用途切開**——逐字說明 `CHEATSHEET.md` 是「**一頁簽名速查，要快速查某個宏就從這裡開始**」，而 `GUIDE.md` 是「**面向任務的解釋、示例、統計約定與完整的契約／邊界情形行為**」（**「查」與「學」分在兩份文件裡**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ 可與 [[glm]]、[[easy-glm]]、[[superglm]]、[[aglm]]、[[duckdb]]、[[insurance-glm-tools]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⭐ **許可為 **MIT****（**實測 `LICENSE` 為 1,064 位元組、21 行的標準 MIT 全文**，GitHub 許可字段亦為 MIT；⚠️ 未核實其是否依賴第三方 SQL 代碼）。**② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ **本次沒有運行它的任何一步****——**未安裝 DuckDB、未 `.read` 該 SQL 文件、未跑 `pytest`、未跑 `duckdb < tests/smoke.sql`、未核對其任何一族與 statsmodels／scikit-learn 的偏差**；**故不主张**其「對到機器精度」成立——⭐ 這一句是**本條最需要後續核實的一處**，而它恰好是**最容易核實的一句**（跑一次 `tests/smoke.sql` 或 `pytest` 即可；⚠️ 本詞條未做）。**③ ⚠️⚠️ **未讀 `regression_macros.sql` 的任何內容****（未核對遞歸 CTE 是否確實實現 IRLS、秩虧時是否確實退回 Nesterov、矩陣求逆與 t 分布是否確實在純 SQL 中完成）。**④ ⚠️ **未核實**其在真實規模數據上的表現**（其自述未給出性能數字，本詞條也不主张它能替代常規實現）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **一處**體裁上的判斷**如實記錄**：**本詞條認為**「在數據庫裡做 GLM」**的意義**不在於省一次導出**，**而在於**數據不出庫**這一點**（⚠️ 其自述只從**工程**角度說明無擴展、無驅動；⭐ 該推斷屬**本詞條**，已如此標注）。**⑥ ⚠️ **★1、fork 0、無 topics**，且**未核實作者背景**。**⑦ ⚠️ **創建在解凍窗口之內（2026-07-12）**，最後推送 2026-09-11。**⑧ ⚠️ **本條目所記為**2026-09-11 所見****。**核實說明**：repo 於 2026-09-11 經倉庫檢索接口與 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 3,270 位元組經 raw 實測逐字核對；`LICENSE` 的存在與**位元組數（1,064）與行數（21）**經 raw 實測；**文件清單經 GitHub API tree 接口實測（15 個文件、1 個目錄，`truncated` 為 false）**；**未克隆、未安裝 DuckDB 或任何依賴、未運行任何 SQL 或測試、未打開任何文件內容、未做任何網絡觀察**。

**ducklm-sql-glm** (repository `lab1702/duckLM`) **is a macro library that moves whole generalised linear models into a database engine**, describing itself verbatim as GLM regression for logistic, linear, Poisson, Gamma, Tweedie, negative binomial and multinomial families in pure DuckDB SQL. **Measured 1 star, 0 forks, licence **MIT** with a licence file measurably present and answering 200 to a raw probe at 1,064 bytes and 21 lines of standard MIT text, the GitHub licence field agreeing, primary language Python, a 920 KB repository, created 2026-07-12, last pushed 2026-09-11** (all GitHub API measurements; ⭐ **creation and push both inside the thaw window**); **the README measures 3,270 bytes**; **the repository measures 15 files and 1 directory**, read through the trees endpoint with truncation false, holding ten test entries plus a cheatsheet, a guide, a licence, a readme and one SQL file. This entry belongs to this round’s theme of **self-verification**, and ⭐⭐⭐ **of the four it states most clearly that it checks itself against an independent implementation**.

Verifiable details (**read from the README and measured in the tree**): ⭐⭐⭐ **① It names another implementation as its alignment target and gives the precision of the agreement** — verbatim, all outputs are verified against statsmodels and scikit-learn to machine precision ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **two independent implementations are named as the reference, so it does not merely say that tests pass but says what it agrees with**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the precision is claimed as machine precision**, ⭐ **which this entry reads as a strong, falsifiable claim: one discovered deviation in one family would make the sentence false**; ⭐⭐⭐ **the seven families are listed individually, so a reader can check family by family rather than accepting a blanket tested**; **and ⭐⭐ every family is said to provide the same six kinds of output**, fit, predict, evaluate, summary with standard errors, p-values and confidence intervals, prediction intervals and influence diagnostics, ⭐ **so alignment is per function rather than per repository**. **② ⭐⭐⭐ It has two test paths, and the second needs no Python** — verbatim, two independent paths, one described verbatim as a Python suite checking every fit, predict and summary against scikit-learn, statsmodels and a numpy-scipy reference on fixed-seed data, **the other described verbatim as a pure-SQL smoke test needing no Python and only the DuckDB command line**, with the command given ⭐⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the two paths do not share a failure mode, which this entry takes as the most concrete instance of the round’s theme, since it is not testing twice but testing once against each of two different dependency sets**; ⭐⭐⭐ **fixed-seed data is stated, so the reference data are reproducible**; **and ⭐⭐ the second path needs no interpreter, so a reader without a Python environment is accounted for**, ⭐ **in contrast with this round’s other entries that explain an unusual dependency instead of removing it**. **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its implementation is described down to the difficult parts, each of which is named** — verbatim, everything runs inside the database, training is Fisher-scoring iteratively reweighted least squares by default with coordinate descent for the L1 term and Nesterov-accelerated gradient descent as an automatic fallback on a rank-deficient design, all implemented with a recursive common table expression and list lambdas sharing a single optimiser core across all families, and even the coefficient covariance, that is the matrix inversion, and the normal and Student-t distributions are computed in pure SQL ⭐⭐⭐ **Four things**: ⭐⭐⭐ **the default algorithm and its two fallbacks are each named, so a reader knows what happens under what condition**; ⭐⭐⭐ **three things that should not live in SQL are named, matrix inversion, the normal distribution and the Student-t distribution**, ⭐ **which this entry records as the most interesting technical detail here, since the library knows which boundary it has crossed and writes the crossing down**; ⭐⭐ **one optimiser core is shared across all families, so the seven are not seven copies**; **and ⭐⭐ the two parameters actuarial work actually needs are supported**, ridge, lasso and elastic-net regularisation alongside an offset or exposure term and sample weights, ⭐ **so using exposure as an offset is not omitted**. **④ ⭐⭐ Its deployment friction is reduced and that reduction is verifiable** — verbatim, that is it, the whole library being one file of macro replacement statements, loaded with a single read command, usable from the command line and from any driver with table and column names passed as strings ⭐⭐ **Three things**: ⭐⭐ **one file and one read command means no installation step**; ⭐⭐ **cross-driver use returns the choice of language to the user**; **and ⭐⭐ passing column names as strings is an honest interface note**, ⭐ **the consequence of building SQL from macros being stated rather than left to be discovered**. **⑤ ⭐⭐ It gives a directly pasteable example** in three steps, building a model table, reading coefficients with standard errors, p-values and confidence intervals, and producing a prediction interval on new data, ⭐ **so a policy table to an interval-bearing prediction takes three lines**. **⑥ ⭐⭐ Its documentation is split by purpose** — verbatim, the cheatsheet is a one-page signature reference to start from when looking something up fast, **and the guide carries task-oriented explanations, examples, statistical conventions and the full contract and edge-case behaviour**, ⭐ **which this entry considers worth copying, since looking up and learning sit in two different files**. **⑦ ⭐⭐ Readable with** [[glm]], [[easy-glm]], [[superglm]], [[aglm]], [[duckdb]] and [[insurance-glm-tools]].

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⭐ The licence is MIT** — **the licence file measures 1,064 bytes and 21 lines of standard MIT text and the GitHub field agrees**, ⚠️ **with no check made of whether third-party SQL code is depended on**. **② ⚠️⚠️⚠️ Nothing in it was run** — **the database engine was not installed, the SQL file was not loaded, the test suite and the smoke test were not run, and no family was checked against statsmodels or scikit-learn**; **so this entry does not claim the machine-precision statement holds**, ⭐ **the single most important thing to verify next for this entry and at the same time the easiest, one test run or smoke test being enough**, ⚠️ **which was not done here**. **③ ⚠️⚠️ No content of the macro file was read**, ⭐ **so whether recursive common table expressions really implement the iterative solver, whether the fallback really triggers on a rank-deficient design, and whether matrix inversion and the t distribution are really done in pure SQL were not checked**. **④ ⚠️ Its behaviour on realistically sized data was not verified**, ⭐ **the repository giving no performance figures and this entry making no claim that it replaces conventional implementations**. **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ One judgement of framing is recorded plainly**: **this entry considers the significance of doing GLMs inside a database to lie not in saving an export but in the data never leaving the database**, ⚠️ **while the repository explains only the engineering benefit of no extensions and no driver, so the inference is this entry’s own and is labelled as such**. **⑥ ⚠️ At 1 star with no forks and no topics the author’s background was not verified**. **⑦ ⚠️ It was created inside the thaw window, on 2026-07-12, and last pushed 2026-09-11**. **⑧ ⚠️ This entry records what was seen on 2026-09-11**. **Verification note**: the repository was read on 2026-09-11 through the repository search endpoint and the GitHub API for stars, licence, language, size and dates; the 3,270-byte README was read via `raw.githubusercontent.com` and checked verbatim; the licence file’s existence, **byte count of 1,064 and line count of 21** were measured over raw; **the file listing was read through the trees endpoint, 15 files and 1 directory with truncation false**; **nothing was cloned, the database engine and no dependency were installed, no SQL or test was run, no file content was read, and no network observation was made**.
